locations.descriptor: A modest American kitchen at night, a small table pushed against the wall stacked with opened envelopes and a calculator, a window over the sink showing dark suburban street outside.
locations.light: the cool blue-white glow of an overhead LED fixture, mixed with a warmer lamp on the table
locations.palette_note: muted teal-grey walls, warm lamp amber, cold fluorescent white

locations.descriptor: A small postwar university office with a wall of grey filing cabinets, a heavy black rotary telephone, and stacks of typed questionnaire forms on a wooden desk beneath a single hanging bulb.
locations.light: a single hanging incandescent bulb over the desk, grey daylight through a tall sash window
locations.palette_note: institutional grey-green, manila folder tan, dull brass

locations.descriptor: A grand Budapest boulevard at the turn of the century, ornate stone apartment facades, a horse-drawn tram track, and the glass awning of a crowded coffee house on the corner.
locations.light: soft overcast daylight off pale stone, warm gaslight glowing inside the coffee house windows
locations.palette_note: pale limestone grey, warm coffee-house amber, dusty rose brick

locations.descriptor: A steep wood-panelled university lecture hall, rows of narrow desks rising toward a high slate blackboard covered in chalked equations, tall arched windows along one side.
locations.light: grey northern daylight through tall arched windows, chalk dust catching in the beams
locations.palette_note: dark walnut brown, chalk-dust white, slate grey

locations.descriptor: A cramped financial newspaper office, desks buried under typewriters and wire-service bulletins, a large wall clock, a basket overflowing with loose banknotes near the door.
locations.light: harsh bare-bulb overhead light, cigarette haze catching in the beam
locations.palette_note: sallow newsprint yellow, iron-grey typewriters, dull banknote sepia

locations.descriptor: A government wartime office lined with ration-board posters, a woman at a switchboard-style desk sorting punch cards, a map of the country pinned with coloured tacks.
locations.light: flat overhead fluorescent-adjacent tube light, grey daylight from a barred window
locations.palette_note: olive drab, ration-poster red, faded map tan

locations.descriptor: A brand-new postwar suburban street, identical small houses with fresh paint, a driveway with a gleaming new automobile, a family unloading a delivery truck of appliances.
locations.light: bright clean midday sun, hard-edged shadows on new concrete
locations.palette_note: fresh white clapboard, chrome silver, lawn green

locations.descriptor: A roadside gas station forecourt at dusk, a hand-lettered price sign propped against the pump, a long line of cars idling bumper to bumper down the block.
locations.light: the sodium-orange glow of the station's overhead canopy lights against a darkening sky
locations.palette_note: sodium orange, faded pump-red, asphalt grey

locations.descriptor: A wood-panelled central bank boardroom, a long polished table surrounded by high-backed leather chairs, a ticker-tape machine clattering in the corner beneath a formal portrait.
locations.light: warm recessed ceiling light pooling on the polished table
locations.palette_note: dark mahogany, brass fittings, deep burgundy leather

locations.descriptor: A quiet suburban street in the financial crisis, a foreclosure notice stapled to a front door, an unmown lawn, a realtor's faded for-sale sign leaning at an angle.
locations.light: flat grey overcast daylight, no shadows
locations.palette_note: washed-out beige, faded for-sale-sign red, overcast grey

locations.descriptor: A row of small downtown shopfronts at midday, security shutters pulled down, a single taped paper notice on a glass door, the street empty of people or traffic.
locations.light: flat bright midday sun with no pedestrians to cast moving shadows
locations.palette_note: bleached shopfront white, dull shutter grey, faded awning red

locations.descriptor: A modern gas station forecourt with a tall digital price sign glowing above the canopy, a driver staring up at the numbers with a fuel nozzle still in hand.
locations.light: the cold LED glare of the digital price sign against dusk
locations.palette_note: digital-sign red and white, canopy fluorescent white, asphalt black

locations.descriptor: A modern central bank press briefing room, a raised podium bearing the seal in front of a wall of muted television screens and a bank of microphones on stands.
locations.light: even bright broadcast lighting from overhead panels, screen glow reflecting on the podium
locations.palette_note: institutional navy, podium walnut, screen-glow blue-white

locations.descriptor: A modern stock exchange floor beneath a soaring wall of glowing ticker displays, traders in shirtsleeves clustered around a terminal as numbers scroll past overhead.
locations.light: the cool electric glow of the ticker wall washing over the floor
locations.palette_note: ticker green and red, floor beige, screen-glow blue

locations.descriptor: A young couple's kitchen table covered in mortgage paperwork and a laptop showing a real-estate listing, a half-packed moving box in the corner of the room.
locations.light: warm table lamp light against a darkening window
locations.palette_note: warm lamp amber, laptop screen blue, cardboard box tan

locations.descriptor: A cavernous institutional gold vault, stacked bars gleaming under rows of caged ceiling lights, a steel cart loaded with bullion beside an open vault door.
locations.light: hard rows of caged fluorescent-style vault lighting reflecting off metal
locations.palette_note: gold-bar yellow, steel grey, deep vault shadow

locations.descriptor: A book-lined academic study, a typewriter and stacked manuscript pages on a wide desk, framed certificates on the wall behind a tall reading lamp.
locations.light: a warm brass reading lamp pooling over the desk, dusk light at the window behind
locations.palette_note: deep bookshelf brown, brass lamp warmth, manuscript cream

motifs: a hand-filled survey questionnaire with checked boxes
a rising and falling hand-drawn line graph
a stack of paper currency or coins
a single lit window in an otherwise dark street
